name: Iron&Oak Metal Fabrication
old_description: Bringing Your Vision into Reality: Custom Steel, Crafted with Precision.
about:
Iron & Oak Metal Fabrication operates from New Fairfield, Connecticut. The company was founded by David DiCairano, who began his career as an ornamental ironworker in the New York City metropolitan area in 2003. After years of union experience working on custom railings, gates, decorative pieces, and large-scale stairs, DiCairano established Iron & Oak to bring that same level of craftsmanship to homeowners and small businesses. The business remains family-run, with DiCairano citing his wife Stacey and their two children as the inspiration behind the venture.

The shop specializes in custom steel fabrication, producing one-of-a-kind pieces ranging from residential and commercial railings to custom table bases, home decor items, and ornamental gates and staircases. Work is performed on a project-by-project basis, with each piece fabricated, welded, and finished in-house. No facility size or employee count is disclosed, but the operation focuses on low-volume, high-mix custom work rather than mass production.

Primary customers include homeowners seeking unique metal fixtures, small businesses needing custom railings or decorative elements, and designers or architects specifying one-off metalwork. Past projects have included residential stair railings, commercial entry gates, and bespoke furniture bases.

DiCairano emphasizes that his union background instilled a commitment to craftsmanship and a high-quality finish on every project. The company positions itself on attention to detail and the ability to translate a client’s vision into a finished metal piece, rather than on speed or volume.
